sourceSummary: Hakodate has evidenced public registry-map coverage through the G-Space Information Center/AIGID conversion of Ministry of Justice registry map XML, with local custodian evidence from the Hakodate Legal Affairs Bureau. Hakodate city also publishes a planning-information viewer, but it is not cadastral parcel data.
queryOutcomes: English and Japanese first-party discovery queries were run and recorded in the city record. The public ArcGIS schema was inspected; its bounded exact-point query returned zero because that layer is an agricultural substitute and this was not treated as absence. The city-specific 2024 source archive was read in native CRS and yielded one exact-point-containing polygon.

requestOutcomes.outcome: HTTP 200; empty FeatureCollection; limited layer, not absence evidence
HTTP 200 download; 183316 source polygons; exact native geometry predicate matched ID H000001917 / map H24440001202002 / parcel 19-59

nativeIdentity.reason: ID alone is repeated in the source; composite provenance is retained here rather than in GeoJSON properties.

scopeLimits: Only one full parcel polygon is retained.
The source covers public-coordinate registry-map polygons; unconverted or arbitrary-coordinate sheets are outside this bounded packet.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax, account, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
The exact WUP point is preserved as latitude/longitude and was not shifted.
uncertainty: Derivative dataset freshness and direct Ministry of Justice service stability require later adapter review.
A real runtime adapter is not qualified by this research packet; runtime readiness remains held.
attempts: Public Hakodate 2024 shapefile download and native CRS exact-point geometry check
